settlementLabel: Settling this payment publishes the keys of the people it passed through, every amount, and the account that is paid.
reclaimLabel: Taking this payment back publishes the whole chain it passed through, your key and the amounts, even if the payment would otherwise have settled privately.
gatewayLabel: Buckspay's server sees this chain, your network address and the time. The private path (when it exists) does not show it the keys.
selfPayLabel: Your wallet address is stored in the records it pays for, until they are closed.
payeeObligation: Settle this payment before {{date}} (UTC). After that the person who paid you may take it back, and the loss is not covered by their bond.
reclaimWindow: You can take an unsettled payment back for {{duration}} after its settlement window, or until its lock ends if that is sooner. An output of a key with no registered device cannot be taken back at all.

claim.late: This loss was reported too late: nothing was burned. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out.
claim.already: The payer signed this money twice and their bond was already destroyed. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out.
claim.reported: The payer signed this money twice. Their bond is destroyed. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out.
claim.noBond: The payer's lock has nothing left to burn. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out.
claim.lockEnded: The payer's lock has ended, so the loss can no longer be filed. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out.
claim.cannotFile: This loss cannot be filed against the payer's lock. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out.
claim.unavailable: Buckspay could not file the loss now. Keep this payment and try again later.

refusal.conflict: The payer signed this money twice: another payment of it was settled first. You were not repaid: the bond is not paid out. Keep this payment.
refusal.noTokenAccount: The account that is paid has no token account for this money yet. Create it in the wallet, then settle again.
refusal.window: The time to settle this payment has run out.
refusal.closed: The time to take this payment back has run out.
refusal.deadline: The signature to take this payment back is out of date. Sign it again.
refusal.horizonUnknown: Buckspay cannot pay for this yet.
refusal.horizon: Buckspay cannot pay for this before {{date}} (UTC). You can pay for it yourself now.
refusal.belowMinimum: This amount is too small for Buckspay to pay for. You can pay for it yourself.
refusal.default: Buckspay cannot pay for this now. You can pay for it yourself.

balance: The balance adds up every account of this wallet that holds this money.
